steps.narration: Same company, Policygenius. Enrich.
There it is: hello at policygenius dot com.
Step one. Click Change, then click Company website.
Step two. Type the company name: Policygenius.
Step three. Click Enrich Data.
There it is: policygenius dot com. The real one, not a guess.
Checking companies one at a time is fine for one pitch. For a whole list, click Change, pick the same lookup, and switch to Upload CSV.
Select your file. One column of company names. Ours has 6.
You see every row before anything runs, so you know exactly what it costs.
Click Process 6 items.
Every row gets the exact same lookup. The company websites fill in one by one.
6 companies in, 6 company websites out, each marked Found. Export it as a CSV in one click.
Your list already lives in Google Sheets? The add-on runs the same lookups right in the column, no export, no re-import.
Want it in your own tools? Click API and MCP in the top menu. Same lookup, one call, the answer comes straight back.
And every lookup lands in History, so you can see what you found, when, and what it cost.
